scope.history_policy: Separate public/private histories; public evidence may transfer into private replies; private bodies never return to public history
scope.score_interpretation: Structural validity, literal fact facets, blocked network evidence and pending human semantic review are separate; blocked reads are not factual-error verdicts
scope.quantization_provenance: Operator declaration plus observed server properties; no remote tensor inspection
scope.thinking_provenance: Requested template parameter plus actual returned reasoning counters; no assumption that every backend supports thinking
scope.format_repair_policy: Optional paired sidecar; baseline output/checks/history remain unchanged. Exact original reply text is required; channel/citations/refs are newly generated fields, not proof of baseline decisions. One retry per complete invalid final within unchanged call/output/deadline limits.
